items.label: Open the 4-heart door
items.note: Core's A-Side is locked behind a Heart Door needing 4 crystal hearts; its B-Side needs 15.

items.label: Red strawberries
items.note: 1 in Into the Core, 3 in Hot and Cold, 1 in Heart of the Mountain. Two of them depend on the hot/cold state of the room.

items.label: Cassette Tape
items.note: At the end of the level, alongside the crystal heart.

items.label: Crystal Heart
items.note: Also at the end of the level; collecting it is necessary to complete Core. The eighth and last A-Side heart. Earns Heart of the Mountain.

items.label: Clear the A-Side
items.note: The one A-Side clear that awards no achievement of its own.

items.label: Clear the B-Side
items.note: Earns Say Goodbye, and unlocks the C-Sides.
